derivation_method: AST pass over ledgerline/ collecting (a) every bare name used as a Call callee, (b) every name bound by an import/from-import, (c) every string in an __all__ assignment; a module-level function is unreferenced when its name is in none of those three sets. Using the AST makes rule R5 true by construction and tests/ is never parsed (rule R3). Script: scripts/derive_A.py
